Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.career_experience: Established starter through Delaware's first FBS season.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.passing: Nearly 3,700 yards with a 23-to-7 touchdown-to-interception ratio.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.rushing: 112 carries for just 235 yards, an average of 2.1 that dragged the team rate down.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.efficiency: Not addressed in guide as a completion rate.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.competition: None described — Minicucci is the settled starter.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.backup: Virtually non-existent, which the guide names as a specific durability risk.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.author_confidence: Positive on production, specific about the risk. The guide starts its returning-production case with him, then flags that he takes a lot of hits with almost nothing behind him.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.positive_case: Nearly 3,700 yards with a 23-to-7 ratio, with all the running backs and top receiver Sean Wilson returning around him — the guide says Delaware is in really good shape on returning production, especially relative to its Conference USA peers.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.concerns: Durability. He takes a lot of hits and the depth behind him is virtually non-existent, and his own rushing average of 2.1 dragged the team to 3.8 yards per carry.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.supporting_cast: Mostly intact but weaker up front. All the running backs and top receiver Sean Wilson return, though his two best offensive linemen do not — Patrick Shupp and Fintan Brose, tackles who combined for 24 starts, with the centre returning. The guide notes the line technically allowed 27 sacks, and just 14 in conference play, saying Minicucci was pretty clearly the reason through scrambles and designed short-yardage runs.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.portal_context: The offensive line was not an area Delaware filled through the portal, so the guide concludes the programme must hope internal options improve.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 5.5 wins, with the guide conceding 6-6 is the most likely outcome given the heavy vig on the Over. Its durability concern is named as a reason. The schedule is called a bit trickier — the long trek to New Mexico State, reigning champion Kennesaw State, and two road games against better Power Four opponents. Projection is 5.73 wins.
Delaware Fightin’ Blue Hens.outlook_dependency: Very high, and specifically on availability. Quarterback durability with no backup is one of the two stated reasons for the Under.

FIU Golden Panthers.status: Transfer — via Appalachian State, originally at Iowa State; replacing Keyone Jenkins.
FIU Golden Panthers.career_experience: Six starts and relief appearances at Appalachian State; a four-star in the 2023 class out of Iowa.
FIU Golden Panthers.passing: A 12-to-2 touchdown-to-interception ratio across six starts and relief appearances at Appalachian State.
FIU Golden Panthers.rushing: Not addressed in guide; the guide notes his possible timeshare partners are bigger running threats.
FIU Golden Panthers.efficiency: Not addressed in guide as a rate.
FIU Golden Panthers.competition: Possible. The guide would not be terribly surprised to see Kohl share time with Delaware transfer Zach Marker or freshman DJ Alexander, both bigger running threats.
FIU Golden Panthers.backup: Delaware transfer Zach Marker and freshman DJ Alexander.
FIU Golden Panthers.author_confidence: Moderate and physically framed. The guide notes he was a four-star in the 2023 class and is a massive human being at 6-foot-7 and 245 pounds.
FIU Golden Panthers.positive_case: A 12-to-2 ratio in his Appalachian State opportunity, recruiting pedigree, and unusual size.
FIU Golden Panthers.concerns: He arrives into wholesale turnover — the leading quarterback, running back, receiver, tackler and defensive back are all gone.
FIU Golden Panthers.scheme_fit: Coordinator Nick Coleman and Willie Simmons landed him together.
FIU Golden Panthers.supporting_cast: Rebuilt. Leading receiver Alex Perry had 530 more receiving yards and 25 more catches than anyone else and is now at Illinois — though the guide reasons that with a new quarterback the loss matters less because chemistry had to be rebuilt anyway.
FIU Golden Panthers.portal_context: Kohl and Zach Marker arrived through the portal; the secondary is described as a grab bag of transfers.
FIU Golden Panthers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 6.5 wins, which the guide labels a pick made for guide purposes because the vig on the Under is heavy. It is explicit that this is not a criticism of the team: FIU will be highly competitive again, plenty capable of seven or eight wins if the ball bounces its way. The schedule argument is the road slate — trips to Jacksonville State, Liberty, Delaware and Kennesaw State, three of the four shortest prices to win the conference. Projection is 5.99 wins.
FIU Golden Panthers.outlook_dependency: Moderate. The guide's Under is a schedule and vig position; the quarterback is one part of the personnel turnover it puts to Simmons.

Jacksonville State Gamecocks.status: Returning starter — the offense now turns fully to him.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.career_experience: Shared the offense with Gavin Wimsatt last season; a 1,000-yard rusher himself.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.rushing: Over 1,000 rushing yards; he and Wimsatt were the two leading rushers behind Cam Cook.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.efficiency: Not addressed in guide as a rate; the guide says the offense was much better with Creel at the helm than with Wimsatt.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.turnovers: Not addressed in guide individually; Jacksonville State benefitted from a +10 turnover margin and is +24 since joining the conference.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.competition: None described — the offense turns fully to Creel.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.author_confidence: High. The guide says Jacksonville State might have the best quarterback in the conference.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.positive_case: Genuine dual production — over 1,000 rushing yards and over 1,500 passing — with the offense measurably more efficient under him than under his predecessor.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.concerns: The supporting cast: Cam Cook and his 1,659 rushing yards are gone, and a new stud running back must emerge.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.scheme_fit: Coordinator Clint Trickett left for Maryland; tight ends coach Taylor Housewright is promoted, bringing experience from two years as coordinator at Montana State. The guide expects a little more throwing from Creel while the staff waits for a back to step forward.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.supporting_cast: Thin at receiver, unsettled at back. Deondre Johnson is the top and really only returning receiver at 6-foot-8, with 724 yards on just 30 receptions; the next closest is tight end Brock Rechsteiner at 36 catches for 383 yards. The guide adds a red-zone inefficiency: 59 trips inside the 20 produced only the 93rd-best touchdown percentage. Candidates to replace Cook are Jalen Likely, who averaged 7.4 yards on seven carries but at 5-foot-8 cannot absorb Cook's workload, plus bigger holdovers Justus Savage and Khristian Lando.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.portal_context: A collection of small-school transfers at receiver alongside homegrown players getting more opportunity.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 7.5 wins, explicitly not a bet, with cautious optimism about an 8-4 regular season. The schedule supports it: road games at Western Kentucky and Delaware, Liberty avoided, and comfortable favouritism expected in all four conference home games. Projection is 7.47 wins.
Jacksonville State Gamecocks.outlook_dependency: High. The guide's summary rests on a programme that can run the ball and might have the best quarterback in the conference.

Kennesaw State Owls.status: New starter, identity undetermined — the guide names two candidates and explicitly leaves the outcome open.
Kennesaw State Owls.previous_school: Rickie Collins comes from Syracuse; Landon Varnes from Mississippi Gulf Coast.
Kennesaw State Owls.career_experience: Landon Varnes was a JUCO starter at Mississippi Gulf Coast who chose the Owls over Arkansas State and Eastern Michigan; Collins' experience is not addressed.
Kennesaw State Owls.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as counts.
Kennesaw State Owls.passing: Varnes threw 31 touchdowns against 14 interceptions at Mississippi Gulf Coast; Collins' production is not addressed.
Kennesaw State Owls.turnovers: Varnes' 14 interceptions are the only figure given.
Kennesaw State Owls.competition: Open, and the guide says so directly — Varnes chose the Owls over Arkansas State and Eastern Michigan, leaving open whether he beats out Collins.
Kennesaw State Owls.backup: The two named candidates are Rickie Collins and Landon Varnes.
Kennesaw State Owls.author_confidence: Low. The guide calls the offense a complete rebuild.
Kennesaw State Owls.positive_case: Varnes' JUCO touchdown production and the fact that he chose Kennesaw State over two other FBS options.
Kennesaw State Owls.concerns: Amari Odom — the quarterback the guide says Jerry Mack hit a home run with, who stabilised the offense and supplied a dual-threat component — is now at Syracuse, and beyond quarterback all of last season's running backs are gone and all but two receivers are elsewhere.
Kennesaw State Owls.scheme_fit: Coordinator Mitch Militello comes from the Josh Heupel tree, and the guide wonders whether he now has the personnel to play faster — Kennesaw State averaged 69 plays per game last season, and it would not be surprising to see that rise.
Kennesaw State Owls.supporting_cast: Essentially gone. All of last season's running backs have left and all but two receivers are elsewhere.
Kennesaw State Owls.portal_context: Mack brought in more than 60 players via the portal last season; 247Sports has 29 graded transfers this cycle in a class ranked third in the conference behind Sam Houston and Liberty.
Kennesaw State Owls.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 6.5 wins, framed starkly — from conference champions to possibly missing a bowl. Its decisive reason is comparative: the conference schedule is tough and the opponents in some of the toss-up games appear to have improved more than the Owls. Projection is 6.34 wins.
Kennesaw State Owls.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide's stated basis for the Under includes basically zero returning production on offense, quarterback first among the losses.
Kennesaw State Owls.conflicts: The guide names two candidates and explicitly leaves open which starts, so this record carries no VSiN preseason expectation for the position.

Liberty Flames.status: Undetermined — the guide says Chadwell has options and that it remains to be seen if any of them are good.
Liberty Flames.previous_school: Deshawn Purdie comes from Wake Forest; Ethan Vasko was a Coastal Carolina transfer already on the roster.
Liberty Flames.career_experience: Purdie is described only through his passing rate; Vasko transferred in from Coastal Carolina and started last season.
Liberty Flames.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as counts.
Liberty Flames.passing: Vasko posted a 10-to-12 touchdown-to-interception ratio and threw for under 2,000 yards; Purdie is only a 50% passer over 282 attempts.
Liberty Flames.rushing: Vasko managed just 2.6 yards per carry on 100 attempts.
Liberty Flames.efficiency: Purdie at 50% across 282 attempts; Vasko's rate is not given.
Liberty Flames.competition: Open. Vasko is still on the roster and Chadwell added Purdie from the portal; the guide concludes that while Chadwell has options, it remains to be seen if any of them are good.
Liberty Flames.backup: The named candidates are Ethan Vasko and Deshawn Purdie.
Liberty Flames.author_confidence: Low. The guide keeps the question explicit — whether quarterback is actually better — while noting depth is stronger.
Liberty Flames.positive_case: The guide's own case is that just about every unit has been improved in some way, and that depth is stronger at quarterback as well as running back.
Liberty Flames.concerns: The scheme requirement is specific and unmet: Chadwell's offense is predicated on heavy pre-snap motion to get players into space, and Vasko did not make those throws, while Purdie completes only half his passes.
Liberty Flames.scheme_fit: The guide frames it as a coincidence of timing — it is hardly a coincidence Chadwell was preparing to leave Coastal Carolina just as Grayson McCall ran out of eligibility.
Liberty Flames.supporting_cast: Improved. Former Army running back Kanye Udoh is called one of the top free-agent pickups in the conference after 1,117 rushing yards in 2024, with Peyton Jones from Duke and Kam Davis from Florida State also promising, and the offensive line looks significantly better. The guide's structural point is that Chadwell's offense is now run-first — 508 carries against 316 pass attempts last season — so the quarterbacks only need to complete enough passes to keep defenses honest.
Liberty Flames.portal_context: Purdie from Wake Forest, plus receiver transfers from Charleston Southern and Indiana, and Udoh via Arizona State from Army.
Liberty Flames.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 8.5 wins, on the basis that just about every unit has been improved in some way. Its biggest selling point is the Shawn Quinn hire at coordinator, and it expects the defense to be better against the run. Projection is 8.24 wins, with a stated liking for Liberty's chances to win more of the close games.
Liberty Flames.outlook_dependency: Moderate. The guide takes the Over while explicitly leaving the quarterback question open, arguing the run-first structure lowers what the position must deliver.
Liberty Flames.conflicts: The guide names two candidates and declines to state an expected starter, so this record carries no VSiN preseason expectation for the position.

Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.status: Returning — a redshirt freshman who took over late last season and stayed with the programme.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.career_experience: Three starts and a couple of relief appearances as a redshirt freshman.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.passing: Over 1,000 yards with a 7-to-0 touchdown-to-interception ratio. Under him the offense scored 26, 31 and 31 points with 541, 460 and 459 yards.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.efficiency: Not addressed in guide as a completion rate; the guide calls the offensive figures under him almost untouchable before Nicholas Vattiato's injury.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.turnovers: No interceptions in the three-start sample.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.competition: None described — Gagliano stayed with the programme despite opening eyes.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.author_confidence: Positive, and pointed about why he did not play sooner. The guide asks directly why he was not starting to begin with and answers structurally rather than personally: it notes the redshirt freshman was surely earning less NIL money than the programme's all-time second-leading passer, and that some teams — especially at the Group of Six level — seem unwilling to move on from entrenched starters they have invested in.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.positive_case: Three starts producing 26, 31 and 31 points on 541, 460 and 459 yards, with a 7-to-0 ratio and useful running.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.concerns: A small sample and a rebuilt supporting cast; the guide answers its own question about rebuilding the offense in a day with a probably not.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.scheme_fit: New coordinator Anthony Scelfo has coached under his father at Southeastern Louisiana since 2021, making this his first time calling plays at FBS level. The guide's wider reasoning is scheme plus conference context — a more robust running game with a more mobile quarterback should help, particularly in Conference USA, where teams that run the ball efficiently often fare better.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.supporting_cast: Rebuilt. Cam'ron Lacy is back after leading the team with 549 yards, but nobody else with 30-plus catches returns and leading rusher Jekail Middlebrook has moved on. The running back room the guide rates much stronger: holdover DJ Taylor at 7.7 yards per carry on 26 attempts, Saginaw Valley State transfer Terence Brown, and Antonio Martin, who averaged over five yards per carry for Southeastern Louisiana in Scelfo's first season as coordinator.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.portal_context: Terence Brown from Saginaw Valley State and Antonio Martin from Southeastern Louisiana; the defense is described as mostly rebuilt via the portal across two cycles.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 4.5 wins: bowl eligibility still looks a tall task, but five wins is attainable, especially at the plus-money price offered. The path runs through non-conference — MTSU lost by 20 to FCS Austin Peay to open last season, so the guide presumes it will be ready for Murray State. Projection is 4.1 wins, with the value stated to be on the Over.
Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders.outlook_dependency: High. The Over is argued from a more mobile quarterback in a new scheme, though the guide's conclusion holds even if the quarterback disappoints — MTSU should run the ball a lot better.

Missouri State Bears.status: New starter, identity undetermined — the guide names two portal arrivals and two holdovers without choosing.
Missouri State Bears.previous_school: Henry Belin comes from Duke; Skyler Locklear from UTEP.
Missouri State Bears.career_experience: Belin spent four years with the Blue Devils and basically never played; Locklear had turnover issues for the Miners.
Missouri State Bears.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as counts.
Missouri State Bears.passing: Not addressed in guide for any candidate. Departing starter Jacob Clark posted a 28-to-11 ratio in a final season played through injuries.
Missouri State Bears.rushing: Not addressed in guide for any candidate.
Missouri State Bears.turnovers: Locklear is described as having had turnover issues at UTEP.
Missouri State Bears.competition: Open among Henry Belin, Skyler Locklear and holdovers Cole Feuerbacher and Elijah Leonard. The guide flags one relationship worth watching: Locklear's quarterbacks coach from last season, Mark Cala, is the new offensive coordinator.
Missouri State Bears.backup: The named candidates are Belin, Locklear, Feuerbacher and Leonard.
Missouri State Bears.author_confidence: Low. The guide's reasoning combines two unknowns — Woods might turn Belin or Locklear into a quality starter, but there are major questions in the trenches, which is a lot to overlook given the uncertainty at the most important position on the field.
Missouri State Bears.positive_case: The guide offers only the possibility that Woods turns one of them into a quality starter, and the Cala-Locklear relationship.
Missouri State Bears.concerns: Neither portal arrival has a record of success, and the guide reads this as a transitional year after which Woods finds a more suitable quarterback in Year 2.
Missouri State Bears.scheme_fit: Mark Cala, the new coordinator, was Locklear's quarterbacks coach at UTEP last season.
Missouri State Bears.supporting_cast: Poor. Clark's absence is made worse by losing Shomari Lawrence, who ran for 1,021 yards and seven touchdowns, with the next leading rusher Ramone Green at just 52 carries for 278 yards. The line is the deeper problem: 52 sacks allowed last season and just 3.5 yards per carry, with the guide showing this is chronic — Missouri State has allowed 40 or more sacks in five of the last six seasons since 2020. It identifies offensive line coach Hussam Ouri, brought from SMU, as possibly the most important person on that sideline.
Missouri State Bears.portal_context: Belin and Locklear are the portal quarterback additions; the guide notes a lot of players followed Ryan Beard to Coastal Carolina or found homes elsewhere.
Missouri State Bears.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 4.5 wins, with the guide noting the juice is heavy but calling it really the only way to look at the number. The schedule closes the case: Missouri State plays all of the conference's top teams, including Western Kentucky, Delaware and Jacksonville State on the road. Projection is 4.12 wins.
Missouri State Bears.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide names uncertainty at the most important position on the field as the thing the trench questions are too much to overlook alongside.
Missouri State Bears.conflicts: The guide names four candidates and declines to state an expected starter, so this record carries no VSiN preseason expectation for the position.

New Mexico State Aggies.status: Transfer — from Furman; described as the leader in the clubhouse rather than a confirmed starter.
New Mexico State Aggies.passing: More than 4,700 yards over roughly 20 starts, with a 30-to-22 touchdown-to-interception ratio.
New Mexico State Aggies.efficiency: Not addressed in guide as a rate.
New Mexico State Aggies.turnovers: 22 interceptions against 30 touchdowns — the guide calls these turnover issues.
New Mexico State Aggies.competition: Live. Adam Damante started two games last season and is the top holdover; Kalani McLeod took his only FBS offer, transferring in from Diablo Valley College. The guide's read is that Hedden's Division I experience makes him the leader in the clubhouse, with everyone likely to get a look at some point.
New Mexico State Aggies.author_confidence: Modest. The guide's framing is that Sanchez and coordinator David Yost have choices rather than an answer.
New Mexico State Aggies.positive_case: Substantial Division I passing volume, and a coordinator in David Yost who has run productive offenses at Texas Tech and Utah State.
New Mexico State Aggies.concerns: Turnover issues at Furman, and a supporting cast the guide describes at length as inadequate.
New Mexico State Aggies.scheme_fit: David Yost has run productive offenses at Texas Tech and Utah State.
New Mexico State Aggies.supporting_cast: The worst rushing attack in the nation at just 77 yards per game, crossing 100 only twice; three of the top four pass-catchers are gone, though the guide notes nobody had eye-popping numbers. Its most interesting observation stretches the question's terms: the offensive line is the unit that looks most improved, with starting experience from the FCS and JUCO ranks plus one returning starter. Sprinter James Jones arrives from Delaware State and true freshman Xavier Rucker is the highest-rated freshman to join the programme.
New Mexico State Aggies.portal_context: 247Sports credits the programme with 26 portal players but ranks the class seventh of the conference's 10 teams.
New Mexico State Aggies.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 4.5 wins. It allows this may be Sanchez's best team, while noting others in Conference USA look improved too. Travel is treated as a structural cost: every road trip is a hike, with conference trips to Miami and the Nashville area plus non-conference journeys to Tallahassee and Honolulu. Projection is 4.61 wins.
New Mexico State Aggies.outlook_dependency: Moderate. The guide's Under is argued from travel, depth and the strength of the rest of the conference rather than from quarterback play.

Sam Houston State Bearkats.status: Returning — the guide names him the projected starter.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.career_experience: Not addressed in guide as a career summary.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.passing: 765 yards while completing 50.4% of his passes.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.turnovers: Not addressed individually; Sam Houston's quarterbacks combined for a 12-to-10 touchdown-to-interception ratio on just 2,209 yards.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.competition: None described — the guide names him the projected starter.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.author_confidence: Very low. The guide isolates the position as responsible, stating that finishing 127th in PPG falls on the players calling out the offense and the person calling it.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.concerns: A 50.4% completion rate, in a quarterback group that produced a 12-to-10 ratio on just 2,209 yards. The guide explicitly defends the run game against the same charge — serviceable at 4.3 yards per carry, with running backs averaging 5.8, 6.7 and 4.2, the overall figure dragged down badly by the quarterbacks.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.scheme_fit: Poor by the guide's own image: Phil Longo is a longtime coordinator who likes tempo and the Air Raid, but is in Year 2 of installing a new system and is attempting to put a Dodge Dart engine into a Geo Prizm.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.supporting_cast: The line was far from great at 36 sacks allowed; the running backs are the one element the guide defends.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.portal_context: 247Sports rated the Bearkats' portal haul the best in the conference, with the secondary a huge focal point — but on defense rather than at quarterback.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 3.5 wins, and the guide observes the betting market agrees, with heavy juice on another 3-9 or worse campaign. This year's roster may be closer to what Longo wants, though probably not close enough for much improvement. Projection is 2.66 wins.
Sam Houston State Bearkats.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide isolates the quarterback position as the root of the offensive collapse it expects to persist.

Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.status: Returning starter — took over from Maverick McIvor as a true freshman.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.career_experience: True freshman last season who took over from McIvor.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.passing: Just under 66% completions with a 9-to-7 touchdown-to-interception ratio.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.turnovers: Seven interceptions against nine touchdown passes.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.competition: None described as live, but the guide names a fallback: Florida State transfer Brock Glenn has a chance at a fresh start if Tisdale falters or is hurt.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.author_confidence: Contextually positive. The guide's judgement is that the numbers were not great, but he was a true freshman, and although he must learn a new playbook he is the most dynamic option on the roster.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.positive_case: A near-66% completion rate as a true freshman, and the most dynamic option on the roster.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.concerns: A near-even touchdown-to-interception ratio, minimal rushing production at 2.1 yards per carry, and a new playbook to learn.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.scheme_fit: New coordinator Bodie Reeder has run some pretty potent passing offenses and the guide judges him a better fit here than at his previous stop at Middle Tennessee. Rick Bowie, who arrived with McIvor from Abilene Christian, was one-and-done.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.supporting_cast: Rebuilt, with the line the genuine upgrade. KD Hutchinson is the only returnee of consequence at the skill positions; Tulsa transfer Ajay Allen will likely lead a by-committee backfield, Georgia Tech transfer Zion Taylor is the most notable receiver added, and Jyzaiah Rockwell arrives after a 1,100-yard FCS season. The offensive line is a hodgepodge of transfers but with a lot more experience and size than last season's group, including an Alabama transfer.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.portal_context: Allen from Tulsa, Taylor from Georgia Tech, Rockwell from the FCS ranks, Glenn from Florida State, plus an Alabama transfer on the line.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 7.5 wins, flagged as something of an alt win total because 6.5 is the prevailing number with very heavy Over vig. The difficulty is the start — Western Kentucky may well go 0-3 — but the guide argues the stage is set to reach the bye at 4-3, with four of the five toughest conference games late in the year. Projection is 7.2 wins.
Western Kentucky Hilltoppers.outlook_dependency: High. The guide's conditional is explicit: if Tisdale can distribute the ball without turning it over and prove more of a running threat, this unit will be cooking with gas quickly.
